\`resolution\_notes\`) or OUT\_OF\_SCOPE (explain why in \`resolution\_notes\`).
Give each gap a stable id (\`gap-1\`, \`gap-2\`, ...) and a priority.
Then fill \`convergence\`: \`should\_continue\` is true with reason
\`open\_gaps\_remain\` when at least one ACADEMIC gap remains and the round is
below 4; otherwise false with reason \`no\_open\_gaps\` or
\`round\_cap\_reached\`. When continuing, set \`next\_round\_topic\` to a focused
topic for the next search round.
